description: Safely add or replace a named operational rules section inside an agent inbound prompt, then route the prompt patch through the governed agent.patch broker. It covers cross-business handoffs, callback language, alert promises, and client-specific operating rules, and leaves the rest of the prompt unchanged.

actor.description: Do not set. Kept for older clients; the signed-in connection identifies you.

authority.description: Do not set. It cannot approve a change: the owner approves through review_url or by being signed in.

business_id.description: Business ID. Required when the agent has multiple accessible assignments.

dry_run.description: Validate and show the prompt patch metadata without writing.

idempotency_key.description: Required for writes. A retry with the same key applies the same proposed prompt change only once.

mode.description: replace (default) swaps the named section for these rules; append adds them to it.

queue_for_approval.description: When authority is missing, create a pending dashboard approval instead of returning needs_approval.

rules.description: Plain-language operational rules to insert as bullets, e.g. callback capture, sister-location boundaries, urgent alert handling.

section_title.description: Prompt section heading to replace/append. Default: Operational handoff rules.

source_ref.description: External source reference, such as a support ticket or assistant conversation ID.

name: configure_agent_business_rules
title: Configure Agent Business Rules
